instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: The detective wanted to reveal the ((identity)) of the thief.
atoms.finishSound: The detective wanted to reveal the identity of the thief.

atoms.b: English is the most widely spoken ((language)) in the world.

atoms.b: The ((cemetery)) is next to the church.
atoms.finishSound: The cemetery is next to the church.

atoms.b: The neighbour’s dog is such a ((nuisance)).
